title: A randomized, placebo-controlled trial to evaluate the safety and efficacy of Debio 4126 in patients with acromegaly previously treated with somatostatin analogs
official: A Phase 3 randomized 3-arm trial (double-blind Debio 4126, placebo control, and open-label Debio 4126), to assess the efficacy and safety of Debio 4126, a 12-week octreotide formulation, in patients with acromegaly previously treated with somatostatin analogs.
summary: Main objective: To assess the maintenance of Insulin-like growth factor 1 (IGF-1) ≤1x Upper limit of normal (ULN) in the double-blind period (Period 1) with Debio 4126 (Arm A) compared to placebo (Arm B) at W36

interventions.name: Ready-to-use suspension resembling 30, 60, or 90 mg Debio 4126 doses

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Patients ≥18 years of age
2. Patients who are receiving octreotide or lanreotide monotherapy for acromegaly for at least 6 months, at a stable dose for the last 12 weeks.
3. IGF-1 at screening ≤1x ULN
4. Acromegaly diagnosis, defined as per protocol
5. Adequate bone marrow, hepatic and renal function
6. To enter Period 2 (Arms A and B): IGF-1 ≤1x ULN at W34, or up to W48 when treated with rescue medication
7. Other protocol-defined criteria apply
Exclusion criteria:
1. Compression of optic chiasm causing visual defects
2. Recent or ongoing cardiovascular or thromboembolic diseases including heart failure, myocardial infarction, stroke, certain arrythmias, pulmonary embolism
3. Other protocol-defined criteria apply
4. Symptomatic cholelithiasis or bile duct dilatation
5. Planned cholecystectomy during the trial duration
6. Acute or chronic pancreatitis
7. Pituitary radiotherapy
8. Uncontrolled hypothyroidism
9. Uncontrolled diabetes
10. Pituitary surgery within 6 months before screening or planned on trial
11. Treatment with pasireotide within 6 months prior to screening, pegvisomant or dopamin agonists within 3 months prior to screening
